about: WIN Injury & Accident Trial Lawyers PC is a personal injury firm with offices in Pasadena and Pomona.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 2 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G1.evidence: 4 of 5 named attorneys hold an active California licence and none carries an adverse status. 1 name(s) could not be told apart from namesakes and are counted neither way

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G2.evidence: No named attorney carries a disbarment, a suspension or a disciplinary resignation on the State Bar of California's record, across the 4 we identified. Administrative suspensions, which the State Bar states are non-disciplinary, are not counted here

G3.evidence: 2 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 5 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 150 public client reviews across 2 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2021-11-09, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

logo.source: The icon the firm's own site declares, copied here rather than hot-linked

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the results page served 2564 characters of text and no figure or mention of a settlement, verdict or recovery, so there was nothing on it to count. Whether the results are held back from the served HTML or the page carries none is not something this check can tell.

score.verdict: 4 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 1 could not be answered from the available records (G3) and does not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar B in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar B (0/15).
